about: The Workshop items that shipped before every item carried its kit (L082, tools/workflows/kit-template.json), as of the date below. test-helpers/every-item-kit.mjs refuses any other item with no kit, refuses an id here that now has a kit or is gone, and the hooks refuse a commit or push that adds an id here: this list only shrinks. Give an item its kit file (<item folder>/kits/<id without its prefix>.json), then take its id out.
